relationships.subject: Suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: suzetrigine blocks the NaV1.8 channels, which are primarily located on peripheral nociceptive neurons

relationships.subject: Suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Suzetrigine showed significant pain intensity elimination over placebo and equivalent results to a hydrocodone/acetaminophen mixture during 48 hours in Phase 3 clinical trials

key_findings: Suzetrigine, a selective peripheral NaV1.8 blocker, was FDA-approved in January 2025 for moderate-to-severe acute pain and matched hydrocodone/acetaminophen in phase 3 post-surgical trials without addiction signals.
Long-term efficacy, cost-effectiveness and use in chronic pain remain unclear.
